headline: عندما ينجز وكيل الويب المهمة لكن الاختبار يعلن فشله: مراجعة بشرية لـ165 مهمة
reviewer: AI editorial review (not a human reader test)
summary: راجع باحثون 165 مهمة لوكيل ويب، فاستعاد التدقيق البشري 12 نجاحاً رفضها الاختبار الآلي، وكشف أن الحلقات والتوقف المبكر وصيغ الإجراءات الخاطئة تفسر إخفاقات كثيرة.

source_evidence.claim: The audited condition contained 165 WebArena-Lite task runs
source_evidence.assessment: Selected, resettable benchmark tasks; one rollout per task-condition, not production traffic

source_evidence.claim: Raw 51/165 accepted; corrected 63/165; 12 false negatives recovered
source_evidence.assessment: Complements are 114/165 raw failures and 102/165 verified failures
32+13+13+9+8+27=102; one primary label per failed trajectory

source_evidence.claim: Guide Text comparison: 57/165 versus 63/165, with 20 gains and 14 regressions
source_evidence.assessment: Net +6; exact paired test p=.392; observational guides do not establish stable causality
91/165 extractable; 7/102 failures claimed 100%, but 0/40 analyzable budget-exhausted failures verified complete
Clearly labelled hypothetical and not attributed to the study

decision: BLOCKED pending actual mobile viewport/browser verification and successful GitHub Actions confirmation
terminology_evidence: Web agent, automatic evaluator, MASM, Guide Text, false negative, trajectory, percentage point and statistical significance are explained at first use or in the glossary.
language_evidence: Arabic draft passed a 20–30 second comprehension simulation; every main proportion carries its numerator and denominator, and the secondary study is isolated in a labelled side box.
